insight: Founded by ex-Google engineers and backed by Basis Set Ventures; grew to 10M+ creators and ~$20M ARR on a $5M raise.
name: OpenArt
tagline: All-in-one AI studio for images, video, and characters.
description: OpenArt is a consumer AI creation platform for generating and editing images and video, building consistent AI characters, and producing multi-scene visual stories. Rather than one proprietary model, it routes across many engines — Stable Diffusion, FLUX, DALL-E, and thousands of community-trained models — and adds LoRA training, canvas editing, and a model-and-prompt marketplace. It began as one of the largest community hubs for Stable Diffusion.

modelSupport.notes: Routes across many image and video models plus thousands of community-trained LoRAs.

edge: Bundles many image and video models with LoRA training, character consistency, and multi-scene story tools in one consumer studio.
pros: Access to many models in one place

references.title: Former Google Employees' AI Startup OpenArt Raises $5 Million
